title: Price levels across economies in 2021 (the ICP benchmark year): PPP conversion factor, market exchange rate, their ratio and GDP per capita
source: World Bank, World Development Indicators (API v2): International Comparison Program (PPP) and IMF International Financial Statistics (exchange rates)
series: PA.NUS.PPP (ppp: PPP conversion factor, GDP, LCU per international $); PA.NUS.FCRF (fx: official exchange rate, LCU per US$, period average); NY.GDP.PCAP.CD (gdppc: GDP per capita, current US$); price_level = ppp / fx, computed by the fetch script (the US = 1)
citation: World Bank, World Development Indicators (last updated 2026-10-08); International Comparison Program 2021.
notes: 193 economies with all three values for 2021; regional and income aggregates excluded (region 'Aggregates' in the WDI country list). price_level is the ratio of the PPP conversion factor to the market exchange rate: the price of GDP in the economy relative to the United States at market exchange rates.
